title: gEdit machines file
description: The machines file of gEdit (<config>/machines.json): the machine configurations and the default machine per profile. Written by hand from src/lib/core/machines/types.ts and src/lib/core/channels/types.ts and held to readMachine, validateMachine, channelBlock, motionBlock and limitsBlock by src/lib/core/machines/schema.test.ts (plan §6.10). Its $defs numberInput and channelParams are also used by profile.schema.json. Prelude skeleton: P4.39b fills it.
